svg.title: Aave-BNS Open Data Science Pipeline
svg.desc: Evidence-bounded public workflow from completed acquisition through verified data migration, offline analysis, governed outputs, and a result-level replication index.

text.tspan: Completed acquisition → verified public data → offline analysis → result-level replication
No blockchain re-query in the public release path
solid = implemented · double-check = verified migration · no new snapshot substituted
address ≠ actor · FAILED_DESIGN ≠ causal effect · HHI ≠ capital
Every claim carries one explicit state
